notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup -> filled quick survey on product settings.

Company snapshot:
- Small indie studio building a social multiplayer mobile title (MMO-lite lobbies). 25 engineers/designers. HQ: US West.
- Primary need: low-latency in-game chat + in-session player assistant (tips, summarization of convo). Live voice-to-text upstreaming planned later.
- Usage expectation: start small (beta = ~200 concurrent users), want to scale to 5k concurrent over 3 months.

Technical / requirements (from call 2026-02-25):
- Interested in Hosted API (self-serve) for quick iteration.
- Latency target: p95 < 150ms for single-turn chat; ideally 50-100ms for short assistant prompts.
- Throughput: spikes during match start (200-300 RPS bursts).
- Cost sensitivity: high — small ARPU, need predictable unit cost. Asking about batching/streaming tradeoffs.
- Moderation/abuse: must detect spam/abusive content in real-time, rate-limit bad actors, and be able to mute or auto-moderate. Need confidence scoring and explainable reasons.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller efficient open models (cost) but would accept Redwood-verified options. Want streaming and function/tool calling for quick structured responses.
- Session management: need per-lobby context (prefix caching) and per-user identity mapping.

Security/compliance:
- SMB, no enterprise SSO yet. Asked about audit logs retention and KMS for keys. Need basic audit_logging and KMS integration.
- Asked: "Do you store chat transcript?" we confirmed we can configure retention and that hosted API is acceptable for initial staging.

Timeline & activities:
- 2026-02-19: inbound signup via website (trial request). Gmail thread created.
- 2026-02-25: discovery call recorded (ff_20260225_001) — discussed latency targets & moderation. SE looped in.
- 2026-02-26: sent pricing deck + small-usage cost example (drive link).
- 2026-03-01: security FAQ requested; provided draft answers.
- 2026-03-02: follow-up email; Sparkwave confirmed interest in a quick POC for latency and moderation.

Quotes / rep notes:
- "Need near-realtime chat for 100 concurrent lobbies — players notice >200ms."
- "We can't afford surprises on token spend — want guardrails + alerts."
- AE note: would prefer fast self-serve onboarding + GA SDK; keeping Dedicated/Private for later.

POC scope suggestion:
- 1-week mini-POC: integrate hosted API in a staging lobby, stream responses, run small synthetic load to capture p95 latency and moderation false-positive rate.
- Metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1k messages, moderation precision/recall on their sample dataset.

Next steps (owner: Ben Carter):
- Send trial API key + quickstart + sample moderation prompts (ASAP).
- Schedule SE demo + POC kickoff for 2026-03-08.
- Provide example batching/streaming config & expected cost calc for target usage.
